jobs: Character reference sheet of one young man, about 19 years old, shown full body three times side by side (front, three-quarter, side), plain warm parchment background. He is lean and tall, with shoulder-length wavy dark-brown hair, light stubble, a strong jaw, a thin scar across his left eyebrow, green eyes. He wears a simple rust-red wool tunic with a leather belt and a small pouch, a cream linen undershirt with rolled sleeves, dark brown trousers, worn leather boots, and a short frayed brown cloak.
Illustrated storybook painting, hand-painted gouache and watercolour with soft brush texture and warm golden light, medieval Europe, rich colours. No text, no letters, no logo.
